tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ 'dir ni mdo sde zab mo las/ /gsungs pa'i don 'ga' mdor bsdus nas/ /rang gzhan dag la phan pa'i ched/ /'god par bya ste de yang ni/ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas 'byung ba'i/ /blo graus bzang mos zhus pa las/ khong khro spong dang byams la gnas/ /chos 'dod sangs rgyas gzugs byed na/ /rtag tu gzugs mdzes 'thob par bshad/ /dus su sbyin gtong 'gyod med sbyin/ /yid 'ong sbyin dang rnam smin la/ /re ba med par sbyin byed na/ /rtag tu longs spyod chen por 'gyur/ /phra ma spong dang log lta spong*/ / dam chos srung dang sems can gzhan/ /byang chub yang dag 'dzin 'jug na/ /mi phyed 'khor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs me tog tshogs kyis mchod/ / gnod sems spong zhing sku gzugs byed/ /rdzogs sangs mos pa rgya che na/ / sangs rgyas zhing du rdzus skye 'gyur/ /gzhan gyis dge ba sgrub pa dang*/ /chos nyan pa la bar mi gcod/ /mchod rten mar me 'bul ba dang*/ /rjes dran ting 'dzin sgom byed na/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /g.yo med dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /gzhan gyi rnyed la ser sna med/ /byang chub spyod la dga' byed na/ /rtag tu dgra ni med par 'gyur/ /ji skad smras bzhin byed pa dang*/ /mdza' bo'i rang bzhin mi 'chab cing*/ /klan ka med par chos nyan dang*/ /chos smras dbyangs skur mi byed na/ /rtag tu ngag tshig btsun par 'gyur/ /sdom pa rnam gsum yang dag len/ /mdo sde zab mor rtag tu mos/ /sems can rnams la byams sems ldan/ /byang chub sems dpar sangs rgyas ltar/ /mos nas las sgrib byang bar 'gyur/ /chos kun bden stong mnyam nyid lta/ /dge la rab brtson sangs rgyas dran/ /sdig bshags dge ba sangs rgyas sar/ /bsngos na bdud las kyis mi tshugs/ /gzhan gyi bsam pa rab rdzogs byed/ /skyabs la mos pa shugs drag dang*/ /rgya chen sbyin pa la 'jug cing*/

/dkon mchog mchod la brtson byed na/ /'chi tshe sangs rgyas mngon mthong bshad/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab mdor/ /stong pa nyid la mos pa dang*/ /byang chub sems ni mi gtong zhing*/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'dzin bgyid na/ /bsod nams thams cad sdud par gsungs/ /gzhan yang mdo sde thar chen las/ /snying rje chen po bskyed pa dang*/ /le lo med cing brtson 'grus bskyed/ /skye shi 'khor ba rmi 'drar shes/ / sangs rgyas ye shes bsam byed na/ /sems la gdung ba med par 'gyur/ /chos kun bdag med ces brjod dang*/ /skye gnas chog la dga' med brjod/ /theg chen bsngags pa brjod byed cing*/ /dge sdig 'bras bu mi brlag ces/ /brjod na nges tshig 'gyod mi 'gyur/ /tshul khrims srung dang mang du thos/ /sbyin gtong rab tu 'byung byed na/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ khe stor mi snyan grags pa dang*/ /smad cing dma' dbab sdug bsngal kyang*/ /mi g.yo legs pa'i phyir 'jug na/ /chos kyi tshul las g.yo mi 'gyur/ /zhan la las 'bras yid ces ston/ /sbyin pa la ni lan mi re/ /dam pa'i chos ni srung ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpar bstod byed na/ /dkar chos thams cad yongs rdzogs 'gyur/ / dge ba yun du sgrub byed dang*/ /nyes pa byung rnams sel bar byed/ /thabs mkhas brtson 'grus dge ba kun/ /byang chub chen por bsngo byed na/ /sa bcu'i bar du bgrod par 'gyur/ /sems can yid dang mthun 'jug dang*/ /dge la yi rang sems bskyed cing*/ /sdig bshags chos 'khor bskor bskul ni/ / thabs la mkhas pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi phan bde sgrub byed cing*/ / rang gi dga' ba yongs 'dor dang*/ /bzod bsgom le lo spong byed na/ /sems can kun gyi ston par 'gyur/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas rjes dran dang*/ /dge kun rdzogs byang phyir bsngo dang*/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ /theg chen bsngags pa sgrog byed na/

/sems bskyed chud mi za bar 'gyur/ /nyan rang yid byed blo 'dor dang*/ /dam chos sgrub pas mi skyo dang*/ /thos pa'i chos kun ston byed na/ /spyod pa gcig tu yongs dag 'gyur/ /theg chen chos la rin chen dang*/ /sman dang dbyig dang 'drar blta dang*/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar lta byed na/ / rin chen chos rnams bsgrub par 'gyur/ /'dus byas chos kun rang bzhin gyis/ /'ongs med 'gog med mi gnas dang*/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung shes na/ /nyes pa'i las kun byang bar 'gyur/ /dran pa nyer gzhag dbang po bsdams/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba stobs bskyed dang*/ /dben par 'du'i dzi spong byed na/ /nyon mongs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /gzhan las mtho snyam mi sems dang*/ /rtag tu kur bsti gus sems ldan/ /gzhan phan sgrub cing bdag mi bstod/ /rnyed dang bkug bsti grags pa kun/ /'tshol med gzhan la chos ston na/ /tshogs mang kun dang mthun par 'gyur/ /dam chos srung zhing ston pa dang*/ / rtag tu ya rabs chos la spyod/ /kun la rnam par rtog med na/ /chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo 'byed 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi skyon la mi rtog dang*/ /zhe sdang can la byams pa sgom/ /chos kun rten 'brel du ston dang*/ /bla med byang chub rtag dran na/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba zad mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu chos kyi sbyin byed dang*/ /gzhan gyi skyon rnams brjod mi byed/ /chos kyis bsdus te ston mkhas dang*/ /zab mo'i chos rnams shes gyur na/ /pha rol phyin rnams rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhi dus mnyen des sems dang ldan/ /dge rtsa mthu ldan byed pa dang*/ /sems can thams cad yongs mi gtong*/ /thabs shes stobs ldan sgom byed na/ /bsam bzhin 'dod par skye bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu sems can don mi skyo/ /sangs rgyas tshad med mchod pa dang*/ /byams sems tshad med sgom par byed/ /sangs rgyas ye shes la mos na/ /byang chub phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/

/sems can don phyir smon lam 'debs/ /sbyin pa'i spyod lam la dad ldan/ /brtson 'grus che la 'dun pa dang*/ /rgyal ba'i chos la mos spyod na/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin mi chad bshad/ /dri med byin gyis zhus pa las/ /phrag dog mi bya phra ma spong*/ /skye bo mang po dge la sbyor/ /byams pa rgya chen sgom byed na/ /bdud rnams 'dul bar byed nus 'gyur/ /ji skad smras bzhin byed pa dang*/ /zab mo'i chos la mos byed cing*/ /yid dam shin tu brtan pa dang*/ /gzhan dag byang chub 'dzin 'jug na/ /zhing rnams g.yo bar byed nus 'gyur/ /mar me sbyin dang dam chos 'dzin/ /bag med rnams la'ang chos ston dang*/ /mchod rten rin chen dra phul na/ /'od zer ldan pa'i lus 'thob 'gyur/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang bu mo sbyin/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas bsngags pa brjod/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sgom na/ /gzungs ni rab tu 'thob par 'gyur/ /'khor ba la ni yid 'byung dang*/ / rang nyid gcig bur gnas la dga'/ /dge la brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ /bya ba mtha' ru phyin byed na/ /ting 'dzin yang dag 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang lus yang bar yid byed dang*/ /sems kyang yang bar yid la byed/ /chos rnams kun la mngon zhen bral/ khams bzhi mkha' dang mnyam shes na/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa 'thob par 'gyur/ khong khro med cing rtsod pa med/ /bde gshegs rten la byi dor byed/ /tshul khrims la gnas legs 'ongs smra/ /chos smrar khro ba med gyur na/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /padmar 'debs gshegs gzugs byas mchod/ /gzhan skyon mi 'dzin dga' bar byed/ /dge rtsa sangs rgyas sar bsngo na/ /sangs rgyas drung du skye bar 'gyur/ /slong la mi brnyas sbyin byin dang*/ /ser sna med par dngos po gtong*/ /rgyal mos lta ngan kun spong na/ /rtag tu longs spyod 'thob par 'gyur/ /chos la ser sna med sbyin dang*/ /mi mthun med cing 'gyod pa sel/

/yang dag gdams ngag ji bzhin ston/ /stong nyid zab mo sgom byed na/ /shes rab chen po 'thob par 'gyur/ /lung nod kha ton gdams ngag 'doms/ /gzhan la yid 'ong ngag tshig smra/ /thar 'dod gzhan la chos ston dang*/ /dge bsngo ting 'dzin la mkhas na/ /rtag tu tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /dam chos srog phyir mi spong zhing*/ /sdig pa'i grogs la mi bsten dang*/ /chos smra ba la skur mi 'debs/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran sgom na/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'phrad par 'gyur/ /mchod rten la ni rin chen gtor/ /dri zhim bdud rtsis mchod rten 'khru/ /spos dang me tog rnams kyis mchod/ /mkhan slob gus pas bsten byed na/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'thob 'gyur/ /chos la khri stan sna tshogs 'bul/ /bsti stang byed pas mi skyo dang*/ / chos smra ba la rgol mi byed/ /sems can byang chub la 'jug na/ /dpe byad brgyad cu 'thob par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 'dzin/ /nyin mtshan phung po gsum pa 'don/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog la mos/ /lus srog mi lta chos sgrub na/ /spobs pa rnam dag 'thob par 'gyur/ /phrag dog med cing ser sna med/ /kun la phan pa'i sems snyam dang*/ /'khor dang chos min mi 'dre na/ /sangs rgyas zhing dag 'thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi 'khor ni 'byed mi byed/ /mi mthun pa dag sdum byed cing*/ /lung nod kha ton byed 'jug dang*/ /phra ma'i tshig rnams spong byed na/ /dge 'dun phun tshogs ldan par 'gyur/ /gzhan mchod byed la phrag dog med/ /pha rol phyin rnams gus pas 'tshol/ /chul 'chos med cing byang sems la/ /ston pa lta bur gus byed na/ /gang 'dod zhing du skye 'gyur bshad/ /klu rgyal rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bsngags brjod cing*/ /chos 'dod g.yeng bar mi byed dang*/ /gzhan gyi 'gyod pa sel byed na/ /mi khom gnas las grol bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni mi gtong dang*/

/tshul khrims srung zhing nyams mi byed/ /smon lam rnam dag 'debs pa dang*/ /gzhan phyir snying rje cher bskyed na/ /lha mi'i skye ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran bsnyen bkur mchod/ /bsngags brjod sku bzhengs lta bar 'dod/ /sangs rgyas zhing du skye bar smon/ /sangs rgyas ye shes chos mos na/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /dge ba'i bshes la bsnyen bkur zhing*/ /chos la gces spras nga rgyal med/ /bka' blo bde zhing mos byed na/ /skye kun bshes gnyen 'phrad par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i yum dang sdud pa las/ /stong nyid zab mo sgom pa dang*/ /sems can yongs su mi gtong zhing*/ /ji skad smras bzhin byed pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas byin gyis brlabs gyur na/ /bdud rnams kun gyis tshugs mi 'gyur/ /sbyin pa yis ni longs spyod ldan/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bde 'gro thob/ /bzod pa'i stobs kyis gzugs mdzes dang*/ /brtson 'grus yon tan gong du 'phel/ /bsam gtan mngon shes la sogs 'grub/ /shes rab kyis ni grol bar bshad/ /gzhan yang mdo sde du ma las/ /nges 'gyur sems bskyed yang dag lta/ /lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang*/ /skyes bu chung 'bring che gsum gyi/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i lam/ / rnam gsum bshad cing de yang ni/ /'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi/ /mngon mtho tsam zhig don gnyer lam/ /skyes bu cung ngu'i lam dngos dang*/ /thar pa tsam zhig don gnyer lam/ /skyes bu 'bring gi lam dngos dang*/ /sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba'i lam/ /skyes bu chen po'i lam dngos dang*/ /thams cad mkhyen pa don gnyer ba/ /gzhir byas mngon mtho nges legs dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub don gnyer gsum/ /skyes bu gsum dang thun mong ba'i/ /lam du bshad de khyad par dbye/ /thog mar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /thar 'dod nges 'byung gal che ste/ /de med legs spyad 'khor ba dang*/ /des zin thar pa'i rgyur 'gyur bshad/

/rdzogs byang bsngos pa'i dge rtsa ni/ /chung yang zad pa med do zhes/ / gsungs phyir dge ba ci bsags pa/ /bsam pa thag pas rdzogs byang bsngo/ /de sogs mdo las gsungs pa'i tshul/ /mtha' yas dpag med mchis na yang*/ /'dir ni rang nyid dad pa yis/ /kun nas bslangs te cha tsam bris/ /ci phyir zhe na mdo las ni/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing*/ /rin chen bkar ste rgyal mchod pas/ /gang gis rgyal ba'i gsung ltar du/ /dam chos tshigs bcad gcig byin yang*/ /bsod nams che bar gsungs phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar ba'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus bzhugs/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 7--PAGE 1-
